description: Example robot (not a default): a robot with no body. It has no hardware, no pair and no drivetrain; every device it has is lent by a browser page that joins it (CONTRACT.md §2.4), so it is online from the start with zero devices. drive, turn and arc answer `unsupported`. `profile` is a contract RobotProfile (CONTRACT.md §3); its limits bound a page's commands and programs like any robot's.

notes: Every device of this robot lives in a browser page a person opened; describe_robot lists the pages.
